india.one_line: India sees AI growth in funding, infrastructure, and defence policy.

themes.title: Karta AI secures seed funding
themes.text: Karta AI raised $3 million in a seed round led by PeerCapital and Cedar Hill Capital to automate complex inbound banking calls, handling about 2 million monthly conversations in 25 languages and cutting query costs by roughly half.

stories.headline: Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls

themes.title: Vultr opens AI supercluster
themes.text: Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, the largest AMD Instinct installation in India and among the world’s biggest.

stories.headline: Vultr launches 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs

themes.title: India drafts defence AI framework
themes.text: India developed a domestic framework to assess AI trustworthiness in defence, focusing on reliability, safety and transparency, and co‑sponsored the first UN informal exchange on military AI.

stories.headline: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence
